title: Silo
tagline: The key to the future lies in the past.
synopsis: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

episodes.title: Freedom Day
episodes.synopsis: Sheriff Becker's plans for the future are thrown off course after his wife meets a hacker with information about the silo.

episodes.title: Holston's Pick
episodes.synopsis: Juliette, an engineer, pieces together what might have led to a co-worker's mysterious death.

episodes.title: Machines
episodes.synopsis: In her hunt for a new sheriff, Mayor Jahns clashes with Bernard. Juliette strikes a deal to keep the generator running.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.synopsis: Juliette tries gaining the trust of Deputy Marnes as they work to uncover the truth about recent tragedies.

episodes.title: The Janitor's Boy
episodes.synopsis: Sims appoints Billings as chief deputy to keep tabs on Juliette, whose efforts to solve two murders lead to a showdown.

episodes.title: The Relic
episodes.synopsis: During her investigation, Juliette uncovers disturbing secrets about someone she thought she knew.

episodes.title: The Flamekeepers
episodes.synopsis: Bernard seeks Juliette's cooperation as he grows increasingly concerned about the silo's security. Juliette asks her father for a favor.

episodes.title: Hanna
episodes.synopsis: New information causes Juliette to see her family's past differently—and she finally gains access to the silo's biggest secrets.

episodes.title: The Getaway
episodes.synopsis: Racked with guilt, Billings sets off on a personal mission, only to discover a mind-blowing clue from Juliette.

episodes.title: Outside
episodes.synopsis: Juliette's fate seems sealed when certain truths finally come to light.

episodes.title: The Engineer
episodes.synopsis: Juliette finds sanctuary in a silo long ago destroyed by war, thinking she's alone.

episodes.title: Order
episodes.synopsis: In Silo 18, shock and unrest take hold in the wake of Juliette doing what no one's done before.

episodes.title: Solo
episodes.synopsis: Bernard turns to Judge Meadows for help. Billings begins to wonder if he's being lied to. Juliette finally meets the man in the vault.

episodes.title: The Harmonium
episodes.synopsis: Juliette sets out on a dangerous quest to retrieve a suit so she can return home and save her silo. Mechanical plans a meeting with Judge Meadows.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.synopsis: Sims finds himself with a new position. Juliette learns Solo isn't being honest. Bernard and Lukas make an important discovery.

episodes.title: Barricades
episodes.synopsis: Bernard enacts a plan to root out Knox, Shirley, and Walker. Billings takes a stand. Solo saves Juliette's life and wants something in return.

episodes.title: The Dive
episodes.synopsis: Lukas is assigned a mission. Mechanical sends a powerful message. Juliette embarks on a perilous descent—and confronts a new danger.

episodes.title: The Book of Quinn
episodes.synopsis: Juliette discovers something's happened to Solo. Bernard makes an offer to Walker. Lukas meets with Salvador Quinn's descendants.

episodes.title: The Safeguard
episodes.synopsis: Billings' faith is shaken. Lukas heads to the down deep. Knox identifies the traitor. Juliette uncovers the truth about Solo's past.

episodes.title: Into the Fire
episodes.synopsis: The rebels make their move—and so does Juliette.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.synopsis: New mayor Juliette can't remember anything from her time outside—or her past.

episodes.title: It's All Good
episodes.synopsis: Billings investigates a disappearance. Daniel Keene has a run-in with a reporter.

episodes.title: A Dark Web
episodes.synopsis: Juliette takes control of her recovery process. Helen suffers consequences of her investigation.

episodes.title: Whatever You Do, Don't Go Home
episodes.synopsis: The race to evade Camille leads Juliette to a shocking discovery. Daniel seeks help from a friend.

episodes.title: Memory
episodes.synopsis: The events following Juliette's return come to light—and unexpected allies are made.

episodes.title: The Drive
episodes.synopsis: Billings and Hank stumble on a new mystery. Daniel and Helen receive a surprising proposition.
